approach.method_basis: The Parent grows fresh molecular graph pools by mutation and crossover of real scored parents, admits canonical unique products under its existing structural rules, and fits a Gaussian process to all accepted scores using integer-count molecular fingerprints and a Tanimoto kernel. It retains the best scored survivors for subsequent breeding. After three nonimproving batches, selection is restricted to the forty highest predictive means; otherwise the whole pool is eligible. At every purchase, GIBBON uses 128 joint latent functions over the fresh pool plus accepted inputs and greedily selects a batch using maximum-information quality and noisy-predictive correlation redundancy. Real feedback updates the next model and breeding state. This information objective also controls the last purchase, when its information cannot influence another decision.
approach.novelty: Add one terminal observed-best decision to this Parent. Only when the remaining real budget fits the announced batch, use its same latent function samples and real incumbent to build a greedy expected-improvement batch. Buy that batch only if its sampled utility strictly exceeds the original GIBBON batch; ties keep the original choice. Earlier purchases and random streams remain identical. The frozen brief has no same-Parent siblings. The older expected-maximum experiment used a Student-t model at every allocation, whereas this change acts only at the final decision of the measured GIBBON algorithm.

observed_bottleneck: The limiting behavior is the terminal information objective: actual code Parent n-294ad2ffe1d4 purchases its final batch for maximum information even though no later purchase can use that information. Its completed Search panel has mean 0.5480225446476307 and seed SD 0.007582384294989663, with all 435 GIBBON batches executed and changed from passive Thompson. The modeled bound rose to 0.5493622170542798 from 0.25447907696143235, while late positive generating-parent gain fell to 0.001744256020427556 from 0.0020240780825076187 and the endpoint fell by 0.059007771563500344 against n-cf8d309c06de. Preserve the recorded refuted mechanism, triggered falsifier, adverse total-allocation contribution and task-safety result. The read-only audit policy/scratch/r0076-02-improve-L01/plan/parent-evidence.json confirms all 15 terminal pools, 128-row sample receipts, real incumbents, 150 joined final purchases and their next-fit censors; Parent equal-session terminal incumbent progress is 0.0007012103952648248. It cites each original log, trajectory, summary and run file and verifies 60 prior input hashes. This horizon fact motivates the terminal decision but does not explain the earlier GIBBON losses or establish sample calibration. The direct counterexample n-645c611d69c8 raised modeled expected-maximum utility at all allocations under its Student-t host but missed its endpoint prediction; its result remains contrary evidence to universal utility superiority.

method_change.previous_method: On n-294ad2ffe1d4, GIBBON maximum-information quality plus noisy-correlation greedy selection controls every purchase, including the last.
method_change.proposed_method: Preserve all earlier GIBBON decisions and change only the terminal decision to strict selection between original GIBBON and incumbent-referenced greedy expected batch improvement on the same latent samples.
method_change.rationale: The actual code Parent executes its information criterion but has no next decision after the terminal labels. Its lower complete endpoint and late gain do not isolate the final batch cause; the frozen intervention tests this single horizon-specific obstacle while preserving earlier adaptive search exactly.

hypothesis: On actual code Parent n-294ad2ffe1d4, modify only the final acquisition decision. Let b be the batch size announced in init and R the authoritative positive budget_remaining on the current init/observe message. If R>b, execute the original Parent path exactly. If R<=b, still execute all original passive Thompson and GIBBON work, including their original random draws, finite fresh-plus-accepted maximum support, alias sharing, quality, noisy correlation, greedy batch B_info and original eligibility E. Reuse the exact already computed joint latent values F[r,i] for each fresh pool index i, in raw score units, for all 128 GIBBON rows; do not sample again or add observation noise. Let h be max(score) over actual accepted records at this announcement. Define U(B)=mean_r(max(h,max_{i in B} F[r,i])-h), with U(empty)=0. Initialize v[r]=h. At each of exactly b positions choose the unused eligible index maximizing mean_r(max(F[r,i]-v[r],0)); break every exact tie, including an all-zero marginal-gain tie, by the smallest original pool index. Update only the temporary covered vector v[r]=max(v[r],F[r,chosen]); do not condition the GP or create feedback. This defines B_greedy. Compute U(B_greedy) and U(B_info) by the identical float64 formula on the identical F and h. Purchase B_greedy only if U(B_greedy)>U(B_info), with no tolerance, margin or tie objective; otherwise purchase B_info in its original order. The mechanism predicts changed final paid sets under positive utility exposure and a strictly greater equal-session realized final-batch incumbent progress over all 15 sessions. The endpoint threshold is a separate reporting target, algebraically sharing that progress difference when prefixes match. No new fit, random panel, maximum approximation, stage schedule, fake label, generator change or earlier allocation change is introduced.

finding_summary.headline: Terminal utility improves its model objective and replaces 42 purchases, but every endpoint stays unchanged
finding_summary.insights:
The terminal information-horizon mismatch was a real, implemented intervention point, but changing that final objective alone did not improve observed best value on this panel. The retained GIBBON calculation and the borrowed best-observed utility both operated as registered; their finite-support, 128-latent-sample and greedy adaptations establish computation rather than calibrated expected oracle gain or optimality. The strict model-utility improvement had actual purchase exposure, so this is a tested downstream counterexample rather than missing execution, empty exposure or merely an inconclusive score. Exact prefixes also mean the endpoint comparison repeats the terminal-progress outcome algebraically; it supplies no independent confirmation. The finite-panel zero effect does not establish population equivalence, separate the inherited components, explain the earlier information-allocation losses or settle the wider approach.

The measured method limitation is that higher sampled incumbent utility on the same available graph support did not reveal a new incumbent. All best-scoring identities were retained from the Parent. One of the two modeled-zero panels nevertheless delivered 0.00240767 real incumbent progress through the retained GIBBON batch, so a zero sample utility did not establish absence of real opportunity. Molecular evidence shows that terminal rerouting also left the broader output character almost unchanged: 228 very small products remain, some high-score families concentrate on a few skeletons, and other families retain substantial ring/scaffold diversity. Thus global scaffold collapse is unsupported; local family refinement and fragment detours coexist with broader exploration. The high-score family with only ten scaffolds has exactly the same trajectory as the Parent and no terminal switch, so it cannot by itself explain why the switched batches failed. A surrogate or ranking model tested against realized incumbent improvements could address an allocation-model limitation; a proposal/search scheme that preserves connected architecture while exposing alternative compact ring/linker families could address a support limitation. These are distinct method classes that could remove the observed kinds of limitation, not established remedies or a selected next plan. This experiment does not distinguish their causal roles, and chemical liabilities are not demonstrated causes of the endpoint result.
finding_summary.results:
All 15 sessions completed, and every earlier choice, accepted label and scientific random-draw receipt matched the code Parent. The terminal calculation passed independent reconstruction on all 128-scenario panels. It switched 12 final batches and replaced 42 of 150 purchased molecules; 3 exact utility ties retained the original ordered batch. Mean modeled terminal improvement rose from 0.03171265 to 0.03354629. All 4350 purchases join to real feedback, with all 150 terminal purchases correctly censored from any subsequent fit or breeding.

The registered useful-transfer prediction nevertheless fails: equal-session real final-batch incumbent progress is 0.0007012104 on both sides, with zero paired change in every one of the 15 sessions and 12 zero-progress sessions. None of the 42 newly bought molecules beats its preterminal incumbent. Mean endpoint remains 0.54802254, with seed population SD 0.00758238; all three seed-macro deltas and all fifteen task/seed endpoint deltas are exactly zero. This triggers the scientific terminal-utility falsifier and misses the separate +0.002 endpoint target. The formal-Anchor comparison remains -0.05900777; task safety passes against the actual Parent and fails against the formal Anchor on sitagliptin. The unchanged global criterion also requires the formal Anchor itself to be the code Parent, so this descendant cannot satisfy that applicability condition.

molecular.headline: Ring-rich aryl amines and fused heterocycles persist, with N-halogenation, undefined stereochemistry and small-fragment detours.
molecular.overall_character: This report describes n-dda4bb4dbf5f against its actual code Parent n-294ad2ffe1d4; the distinct formal Anchor n-cf8d309c06de is not the molecular comparator. The frozen context separately marks Child evaluation complete and Parent pairing complete on Search seeds 0, 1 and 2. All fifteen trusted Child trajectories and fifteen published Parent trajectories were present and read; no task or paired trajectory is missing. Each side contains 4,350 accepted optimizer products and 150 supplied initial records. Unpurchased pools and rejected attempts are outside this chemistry census. The earliest best-scoring identity is the same in every paired session; 42 of the 150 final-batch identities differ. The frozen comparison records zero endpoint differences, which does not imply identical complete output. Indole-like carboxamides, N-rich carbonyl/imine heterocycles, aryl-linked saturated amines and elaborate lactam/polycycle systems dominate. Ring-closure text rates span 0.8621 to 0.9759 and aromatic-atom text presence rates span 0.8563 to 0.969; these are molecule-level text presence, not atom fractions. RDKit finds N-halogen bonds in 1,151 products, O-O bonds in 167 and at most six heavy atoms in 228, compared with Parent counts 1,149, 168 and 228. There are 2,577 products with unassigned tetrahedral centres and none with an assigned centre; Parent has 2,579 and none. Formal charge is absent, but 1,386 products contain the audit unacylated-aliphatic-amine proxy, so neutral notation does not mean no ionisable chemistry. Familiar medicinal fragments coexist with potentially reactive substitutions and difficult ring arrangements, supporting questionable synthetic plausibility and weak overall drug-likeness rather than a claim that all products are impossible. Structural diversity is moderate: many ring skeletons occur, but some high-score families concentrate strongly. Full means all 290 optimizer rows per session; late means optimizer ordinals 146 through 290. Pooled high and low deciles contain 87 products per task, with score ties resolved by seed then evaluation order. Heavy-atom, ring and Murcko counts use RDKit 2023.09.6; scaffold counts include the empty acyclic scaffold. The amine flag is a structural proxy, not a pKa estimate; ring perception is not geometry validation. Carbon-centred cumulene flags exclude sulfur-centred O=S=O. These are output associations, not mechanism activation, component contribution, synthetic-route, stability or biological measurements. The current observations extend the related chemistry recorded in nodes/n-294ad2ffe1d4/molecular.json; historical Parent-versus-Anchor contrasts are not relabelled as this Child comparison. Frozen request: policy/requests/r0076-02-improve-L01-molecular-assess-6459698c678027d2.json. Complete derived measurements and their hashed inputs: policy/scratch/r0076-02-improve-L01/molecular/chemistry-summary.json. Run-local Child copies preserve the trusted staging bytes and do not expand SMILES citation authority.

There are 31 products with at most six heavy atoms. Large repeated-core products also occur, so novelty does not consistently preserve useful connected architecture.
The imine/thiocarbonyl and heteroatom-halogen variants have no demonstrated synthesis or stability; accepted valence alone does not establish either.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
